svg.title: YOLO proposes, DETR refines: full architecture

text.tspan: Full architecture with tensor shapes. Reference setup: 640 × 640 input ·
YOLO-style CNN: e.g. HGNetv2, CSPDarknet, ResNet
cost: dense convolutions over every pixel
the same idea as YOLO's neck
the “YOLO” part: one quick guess per position, all 8,400 in parallel
• no NMS: duplicates are kept on purpose
• both are detached: no gradient through the top-
• own loss (encoder aux loss) → good proposals
memory (8,400×256) → values for cross-attention in every layer
softmax over the 12 (level, point) pairs of each head
→ the points move with the box and scale with its size
5. output = Σ weight × value per head → concat → Linear
96 samples per query per layer, instead of 8,400 positions
+ 96 samples): it does not grow with the image size
no NMS, no IoU threshold to tune
speed knob: stop after fewer decoder layers
export ONNX with opset ≥ 16 (needed for grid_sample)
GPU: TensorRT FP16 runs this family well
NPUs, OpenVINO, Hailo: check grid_sample support
tuning knobs: input size, backbone size,
for each image, cost of pairing prediction

decoder layer and the final layer

Companion to the video “YOLO proposes, DETR refines”. Values are typical defaults (RT-DETR / D-FINE); exact channels and layer counts depend on the backbone and model size.
